monthly.note_en: Less than 5 game mod rigging related items were released this month (September 2026), so the list is supplemented with the most recent (August 2026) official releases.

items.name: Animcraft 6.0
items.why: Animcraft 6.0 引入了全新的 AI 角色綁骨與蒙皮模組，以及基於 NVIDIA Kimodo 模型的新型文字轉動畫模組，顯著提升了跨 DCC 應用程式的動畫庫構建能力。
items.why_en: Animcraft 6.0 introduces a new AI character rigging and skinning module and a new clip-based text-to-animation module based on the NVIDIA Kimodo model, significantly enhancing animation library building across DCC applications.

items.name: Meshy Auto-rigging & Animation API
items.why: Meshy 正式推出了自動綁骨與動畫 API，讓開發者能夠以程式化方式自動綁定和動畫化 3D 模型，進一步整合其領先的 AI 3D 內容生成平台。
items.why_en: Meshy officially introduced its Auto-rigging & Animation API, enabling developers to programmatically auto-rig and animate 3D models, further integrating its leading AI 3D content generation platform.

items.name: Autodesk Flow Studio (臉部動畫與 MetaHuman 匯出增強)
items.why: Autodesk Flow Studio 推出改進的臉部動畫模型，提供更高品質、更自然的臉部動作，並新增了使用 AI 動態捕捉將 MetaHuman 身體動畫匯出到 Unreal Engine 的功能，強化了遊戲引擎整合。
items.why_en: Autodesk Flow Studio released an improved Face Animation model for higher-quality, more natural facial motion, and added support for exporting MetaHuman body animations using AI Motion Capture to Unreal Engine, enhancing game engine integration.

items.name: mGear Anim Picker 2.0
items.why: Maya 的開源角色綁骨框架 mGear 推出了 Anim Picker 2.0，這是其動畫選擇工具的完全重寫版本，引入了向量形狀、互動式小部件和視埠釘選等新功能，大幅提升動畫師的工作效率。
items.why_en: mGear, the open-source character rigging framework for Maya, released Anim Picker 2.0, a complete rewrite of its animation picking tool, introducing new features like vector shapes, interactive widgets, and viewport pins, significantly boosting animator productivity.

items.name: Cascadeur 2026.2
items.why: Cascadeur 2026.2 帶來了多項動畫工作流程改進，包括增強的四足動物自動擺姿 (AutoPosing) 和內插中的緩和 (Easing) 控制，儘管動畫圖層仍處於 Alpha 階段，但其他功能已正式發佈。
items.why_en: Cascadeur 2026.2 brings several animation workflow improvements, including enhanced quadruped AutoPosing and Easing controls in interpolation, with other features generally available despite animation layers being in Alpha.
